title: Record the ten-call Q8 rank floor
body:
## Summary
- At ten calls the block rank floor removes `(0,10)` and `(2,8)` from shape `(4,0)`, and `(1,9)` from shape `(3,1)`, together with the swapped labels.
- The balanced shape keeps four splits, and an explicit rank fixture realizes `(2,8)` at rank 2. No word and no new kappa.
